travelDistanceM.description: The real travel distance, in metres, between fromLocationCode and toLocationCode as reported by facility-layout at commit time (ADR-0017). Omitted entirely — not defaulted to 0 — when no travel-distance hint was recorded: either the request did not supply both location codes, or the lookup was unavailable/unknown/refused (e.g. the two locations sit in different zones).

travelDistanceEstimated.description: True when the recorded travel distance used a zone's bay pitch fallback rather than real aisle centreline geometry (mirrors facility-layout's own TravelDistance.estimated field). Omitted together with travelDistanceM when no hint was recorded.
